mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the prior month indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >1% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% in the prior month, it signals a contraction in the real economy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index above 4.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% and 0.2 percentage points respectively signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 2% in the prior month, it signals a collapse in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%.
